subject: .claude/agents/code-reviewer.md
cmd: python -c "import pathlib,re,shutil,subprocess as s;B=shutil.which('bash');F=chr(96)*3;q=chr(34);E=lambda c:bool(re.search('(?i)grep: (unknown|invalid|illegal) option|usage: grep',s.run([B,'-c',c],capture_output=True,input=b'').stderr.decode(errors='replace')));assert E('grep -c '+q+'-> '+q+' -') and not E('grep -c -e '+q+'-> '+q+' -');L=[re.sub(r'^\s*(&&|\|\|)','true &&',l) for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('.claude/agents').iterdir()) if p.suffix=='.md' for t in [p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').replace(chr(92)+chr(10),' ').split(chr(10))] for i,l in enumerate(t) if re.search(r'\bgrep\b',l) and not l.lstrip().startswith('#') and sum(x.lstrip().startswith(F) for x in t[:i])%2];print(any(E(re.sub(r'[0-9&]?>[ ]*(&[0-9]|/dev/null)','',l)) for l in L))"
